Ekko

the Boy Who Shattered Time
Mid laneJungle lane

Ekko is a time-bending assassin who dives in, bursts a target, and rewinds himself out of danger with his ultimate. He's one of the strongest mids this patch: very safe for an assassin, great at roaming, and strong in both mid and jungle. Pick him if you like high-mobility plays with a built-in escape button.

When to pick Ekko

✓ Safe blind pick

Safe to pick early: Chronobreak gives him an escape in bad matchups, and he can also go jungle if your team needs it.

Pick into

  • Immobile mages like Orianna, Syndra and Viktor
  • Squishy backlines he can dive and escape from
  • Teams that group tightly, for Parallel Convergence stuns

Avoid into

  • Durable mages like Vladimir who outlast his burst
  • Champions who dodge his combo, like Fizz
  • Teams with lots of crowd control that stop him before he can rewind

Great teammates

LissandraHer stun locks targets down for your burst.
MalphiteHis engage groups enemies for your Parallel Convergence.
AhriHer charm sets up easy dives for both of you.

Your team needs: Pick Ekko when your team has some engage or a frontline, so you can dive the backline after the fight starts.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Chronobreak rewinds him to safety and heals him, so he can take risky fights
  • Strong burst with his passive three-hit proc and Hail of Blades
  • Parallel Convergence's stun lets him set up long-range plays
  • Strong roamer and skirmisher; also a great jungler

Weaknesses

  • Chronobreak shows its return point as a ghost image, so smart enemies wait for him there
  • Weak if he falls behind; an assassin with no items does little damage
  • Struggles against durable mages like Vladimir who can outlast his burst
  • Parallel Convergence takes a few seconds to land, so it needs good prediction

Power spikes

  • Level 3: full combo; Hail of Blades makes your first three attacks very fast
  • Level 6: Chronobreak lets you take risky trades and roams
  • First item (Stormsurge): huge burst on squishy targets and extra move speed
  • Two items (Dusk and Dawn): stronger extended fights with spell-empowered attacks
  • Three items (Rabadon's Deathcap): one-shot range on most carries

Top tips

  • Your passive procs after three hits on the same target. Count your hits in every trade.
  • Phase Dive's auto can blink you onto a target over a wall.
  • Walk around for a few seconds before diving so your Chronobreak ghost is in a safe spot.
  • Parallel Convergence lands after a delay. Cast it in a chokepoint before a fight starts.
  • Chronobreak can also be an offensive spell: rewind into a group to deal damage.
  • If you're ahead, Zhonya's Hourglass is the most common fourth item against assassins and divers.
